commands.key: hold Command (H) for a wheel, or tap for the last command; a teammate's name token shows who answers

list.what: attack my target (the crosshair or lock-on)
follow me, fight only what attacks us
start a squad or nature combo on my target (picks one you can do)
the medic heals the most hurt

commands.response: a command is obeyed after 4 ticks at cohesion 60+, 10 ticks at 30 to 59, 16 ticks under 30; under 30 a teammate ignores 1 in 10 (except Umino's Steady Voice)

formations.what: side by side, facing the threat: guard +10% for all
a wedge with you at the front: your dash attacks +15%; teammates follow your target
back to back around a protect target: no back attacks on anyone
split around the target (opens the pincer squad combo)
spread in cover, silent: first strikes are crits (stealth objectives)

cohesion.source: BONDS.md section 7: the squad's cohesion (0 to 100) from Shinobi Life (squad_cohesion)

effects.cover: once per fight a teammate intercepts a hit that would down you

cohesion.friendship: a teammate at friendship 6+ joins nature combos with you without a command; at 8+ they call combos themselves (bark: combo_call)
cohesion.experiences: every squad combo landed is a shared experience for the bond engine (kind: spar or mission)

teammates.roles: Progression's squad roles drive the AI: vanguard (close), support (mid, throws and jutsu), sensor (far, reveals), medic (heals)
teammates.loadouts: teammates have loadout files like enemies (combat:ally.<role id>), growing with the story
teammates.never_killed: squadmates are knocked out, never killed (ROADMAP); downed teammates can be revived
teammates.friendly_fire: off for direct hits; area jutsu push allies but never hurt them (Hard: 25% damage)
